W6 after E059. Time ≈ 0.1 s fixed + steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost is pixel-proportional compute plus a bandwidth-bound part (BN/GELU/pointwise, ~27% of a 32 px step). Tip E049 reads 5.198 s and 0.7535 on seeds 0–2. Rebuilds of the same commit read 5.198, 5.206, 5.223 and 5.193 s, so time noise is about ±0.03 s. The 3-seed accuracy mean moves about ±0.2 pp across rebuilds. E049's builds read 0.7535, 0.7552 and 0.7536.

Mechanisms:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 1–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near that dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048). E059 read E046 at 5.19 s, which is not faster than E049 at 5.198. So rebuild time noise (±0.1 s) can mask the 0.25-epoch difference of ~0.12 s.
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share, because a frozen block also skips BN/GELU backward, the optimizer update and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049).
4. Group 1 needs steady training and 32 px exposure (E037, E054, E055).
5. Averaging, LS, warm-up, Lookahead interval and BN recalibration are null or negative. wd ×0.5 gave about +0.2 pp. The recipe is near a local optimum.
6. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses more than it saves.
7. Build noise and seed-set winner's curse (0.1–0.2 pp) dominate every decision under 0.15 pp. The population mean is about 0.752–0.754.
8. Time forecasts: same-commit rebuilds land near 5.2 s. New trims land 0.1–0.2 s below my naive forecasts.

Unsure: whether coarse labels ship in the training data, the true rebuild SD, and PCIe transfer.

The remaining ideas are mostly sub-1% effects: whitening detach at 6%, BN scale freeze. I094 is a diagnostic. Coarse labels likely cannot be used, because the task's TrainingData has only fine labels.
